description: One box per character for one-time codes, such as a 6-digit verification code sent by SMS or WhatsApp.

separator.title: With Separator
separator.description: Split the boxes into two groups. pattern allows numbers only.

states.title: Error & Disabled
states.description: Add aria-invalid to every slot for an error, or disabled to InputOTP.

props.maxLength: Number of characters (= number of boxes).
props.onComplete: Called when every box is filled.
props.pattern: Regex of allowed characters, e.g. REGEXP_ONLY_DIGITS.
